scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-extrabold text-slate-900
scales.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-bold text-slate-900

visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-xl for main cards, rounded-lg for buttons and smaller elements, rounded-2xl for prominent marketing containers.
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for default card states, shadow-md with -translate-y-1 for interactive hover states.
visual_enhancers.whitespace: Generous spacing. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards, gap-6 or gap-8 between layout sections to ensure uncluttered feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200 for sticky headers.

components.buttons: Clear, easily clickable. Minimum 44px height for mobile tap targets. Rounded-lg. Primary button in secondary blue (#0284C7) or primary navy (#0F172A).
components.job_cards: Card with padding p-5 or p-6. Top row: Company Logo (h-12 w-12 rounded-lg object-cover border border-slate-100), Job Title, Company Name. Badges for Job Type and 'Baru'. Subtle hover translate-y-1 with shadow-md.
components.inputs: Height 44px or 48px, rounded-lg, border border-slate-300, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-500. Clear placeholder text.
components.category_chips: Rounded-full, px-4 py-2, bg-white border border-slate-200, hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 text-sm font-medium transition-colors.
components.badges: px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold. e.g. bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 for job types.

layouts.general: High whitespace, mobile-first priority. Ensure touch targets are large and text is highly legible.
layouts.homepage: Hero section with background image (overlay bg-slate-900/70) OR clean split layout with solid light background and minimal graphic. Large search box prominent. Followed by popular categories and latest jobs grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3).
layouts.dashboards: Sidebar navigation (hidden on mobile behind hamburger). Main content area with dense bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) for stats, standard vertical list layout for jobs/applicants.
layouts.job_detail: Two column on desktop: Left (Main job description, requirements), Right (Sticky apply card with salary, location, WhatsApp button, Apply button).

motion.hover: Subtle transform translate-y-[-2px] and shadow elevation for cards. Background color shifts for buttons.
motion.page_transition: Simple fade-in (opacity 0 to 1) for main content areas to prevent jarring loads.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast against white/slate background is APCA/WCAG compliant.
accessibility.touch_targets: All clickable elements min 44x44px for mobile devices.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all interactive elements (focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='apply-job-button').

media.icons: Use lucide-react for all icons. Keep strokes clean and consistent.

hero_background.description: Jakarta urban skyline for hero background overlay
Two young professional women smiling in an office

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all text is strictly in Bahasa Indonesia.
Implement a light theme as requested, emphasizing lots of white space (p-6, p-8) and uncluttered views.
Use standard Tailwind classes. Do not use generic 🤖🧠 emojis. Use lucide-react icons.
NEVER use transparent backgrounds for sticky headers or dropdown menus. Use solid white or glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90).
Provide clear testing attributes (data-testid) for all buttons, inputs, and links.
Use standard HTML inputs for basic text/search, but Shadcn components for complex interactions like Select, Dialog, Tabs.
Do not use full-screen gradients. Keep the background clean white (#FFFFFF) or very light slate (#F8FAFC).
Create 3 distinct dashboards (Candidate, Company, Admin) and a public facing job listing/search page.
Buttons should have clear color definitions: Primary actions in Navy (#0F172A) or Blue (#0284C7).
You have .js files not .tsx file, so write components strictly as .js / .jsx semantics without TypeScript typings.
For Shadcn components, use or adapt the .js versions.
Apply specific formatting for job numbers like salary (Rp 5.000.000) natively.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific property transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Keep text left-aligned by default for readability.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use the provided image URLs.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
